title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani wins Rajeshwari's appreciation with her health mix despite past humiliation. Anbu surprises Kanmani by arranging a decorated swing, fulfilling her wish to swing.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi and Nalini uncover that Anand's supposed adoptive mother is an impostor. Paraman is left helpless after failing to trace the real buyer of the gun used in Ashok's murder.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Swetha encourages Mahesh to stay strong as others taunt him about his father's crime. Meanwhile, Abinaya plans to move to Bangalore with Sudar after securing a job.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: At the village elders' request, Manjamalai invites Mayandi to their temple festival. Unwilling to face those who humiliated her, Meenatchi refuses to accompany Mayandi.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Lakshmi's worsening health due to tension leads Bagyaraj and Mathi to take her to the hospital. Malar is shocked to see Thangaraj arrive at her mother's home after following them.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Raji suspects the brothers while Kathir and Senthil encourage Saravanan's secret wedding with Anjali. Later, Gomathi unknowingly helps him leave Pandian's shop work.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran fears Chandayatha may cause problems for the family. Chandayatha wakes early for household chores, while Nila also rises early to assist her with the work.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Nachiyar praises Vijaya and invites Rohini and Manoj to lunch. As Annamalai and Nachiyar depart for the village, Muthu, Meena, and Annamalai join her, hiding her memory loss.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Karuppu gets coolers for Vellathai and Perumatha. Later, Abinav gives poison to Eshwari and Chithra for Sethupathi's eye camp while shocked as Vellathai demands care.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Sethupathi presses Kasthuri to accept his love and warns her about Karthik's interference. Madhu is upset as Arjun remains determined to quit the company.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan and his brothers fight back against the scammers' gang and hand them over to the police. Kandhasamy rejoices after recovering their hard-earned money.
